label: FP
reason: The XSS vulnerability claim is invalid because the user-controlled input is sanitized via org.apache.commons.lang.StringEscapeUtils.escapeHtml(param) before being passed to the HTML encoder in encodeForHTML. The value is properly escaped before being rendered in the response.

evidence.note: The parameter is sanitized using StringEscapeUtils.escapeHtml before reaching the HTML encoding step
The encoded output uses ESAPI.encodeForHTML which further escapes the content, preventing XSS
